resources.string: Observed transport comes from Android\'s default-network capabilities. It is reported separately from each test\'s configured mode: a LAN address alone does not prove Wi-Fi.

Connectivity, reliability and wireless-observation sessions only. No security-policy tests are implemented.
Opt-in. Records Android Wi-Fi telemetry (RSSI, frequency, link speed) — not CSI. SSID/BSSID are not collected. Duration 10–600 s, sampling 1000–10000 ms, probes 2000–30000 ms.
App-side evidence only. Statuses here are provisional; the Mac dashboard derives final statuses using server evidence.
